title: tops-fmri BPB_SCORES payload
description: Flat {str:number} JSON emitted by checks/evaluate_external.py between the BPB_SCORES sentinels. All 9 keys are required so leaderboard columns line up 1:1 with the fmri-analysis category metric set in categories.yaml.

study4_score.description: Mean of the four Study4 Pearson r (per condition), each clipped to [0,1].

study5_score.description: Mean chance-centered Study5 discrimination score: max(0, 2*AUC-1) per site, so chance AUC=0.5 maps to 0.

study4_SBP_SP_r.description: Raw Pearson r between predicted response and hidden pain rating on Study4 SBP_SP.

study4_SBP_REST_r.description: Raw Pearson r on Study4 SBP_REST.

study4_CBP_SP_r.description: Raw Pearson r on Study4 CBP_SP.

study4_CBP_REST_r.description: Raw Pearson r on Study4 CBP_REST.

study5_JP_auc.description: AUC discriminating CBP vs HC on Study5 JP site.

study5_UK_auc.description: AUC discriminating CBP vs HC on Study5 UK site.
